library_preparation_preflight.summary: Meaningful SFTP coverage requires a reachable SFTP server; the client dependencies are already transitive.
library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Create an in-process Apache MINA SSHD SFTP server on localhost using the transitive sshd-sftp dependency. Configure temporary directories, credentials or keys, host-key handling, and exercise session creation plus inbound, outbound, and gateway operations. Avoid requiring an external Docker image.
risks: Tests that only instantiate configuration classes will provide shallow coverage.
Ensure the embedded server is started and stopped reliably and uses dynamically assigned ports.
